records: Coinbase Q3 figures are company-reported and company-wide; they do not disclose XRP-specific customer balances, collateral usage, net flows or market-making inventory. GAAP net income includes a large crypto-investment gain.
Circle's USDC circulation contraction is an issuer-level supply measure. It does not identify destination assets, redemption holders, exchange routing or rotation into XRP/RLUSD.

Reuters/AP report the Binance incident and issuer freeze amounts, but the exact cause, customer loss, recovery and asset composition of Ripple's reported roughly $200M freeze remain unknown. Do not label it native XRP.

Alpha Finance's XRP-specific 30-trading-session flow and cross-asset 30-calendar-day flow use different windows and potentially different fund populations. The Oct 29 XRP row was not yet settled in the cross-asset page; no issuer-level common series exists.

Bitnomial's XRP collateral acceptance is venue-specific: current page lists a 40% haircut and $15M notional cap. Actual deposited balances, utilization, volumes, margin concentration and customer adoption are not disclosed here.

The CFTC Dec 8, 2025 collateral pilot announcement names BTC, ETH and USDC; it does not name XRP. That does not negate Bitnomial's separate venue-specific acceptance and must not be conflated with it.

XRPL 3.3.0 release inclusion and XLS standard status do not equal mainnet activation. Independent node dashboards differ by one vote for several amendments; exact vote counts require direct point-in-time validated-ledger/API corroboration.
The Kamilah/Camila/Camilla Stevenson spelling variants do not establish that the channel owner is the requested Camilla Stephenson. Public-video inventory remains partial and identity unresolved.

The XRP ledger validator's 15-test suite passed on code head 7074a97, but the subsequent ledger/source append in this snapshot requires a fresh exact-head run. Full repository CI was not run on the research branch.

The controlled-approval workflow produced push-event runs with zero jobs even though inspected main/research workflow files declare workflow_dispatch only. The event/version discrepancy remains unresolved.

No live authentication or structured handoff was verified for Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle or Databricks in this run. The nine-platform map remains design-only beyond tested GitHub connector access.
